clubIntro.title: Metal is inherited. Belonging is chosen.
clubIntro.lead: Legacy Fan is not a store: it is a circle of collectors who value silver .999 and copper .999 for what they truly are, art that endures. Membership means accessing first, owning what few will hold and belonging to something greater than any single piece.

reasons.title: Craftsmanship that endures
reasons.body: Every piece in silver .999 and copper .999 is born of craft, precision and an attention to detail that sets a true collection apart from a mere object.

reasons.title: Access before anyone else
reasons.body: Members enter first: early presales, limited editions and launches reserved for those who belong to the circle.

reasons.title: One community, one legacy
reasons.body: A member number, a private community and the certainty of collecting alongside those who share the same passion for detail.

clubIntro.closing: Choose how you wish to begin your legacy.

home.heroTagline: Premium precious-metal collecting for those who arrive first.
home.heroBody: Choose your access level and join the first generation of Legacy Fan members: physical silver .999 and copper .999 pieces, Mystery Boxes, a member number, a private community and priority on future collections.
home.marquee: Limited edition · silver .999 · copper .999 · Ultra High Relief · Collectible art · Official license

pillars.title: Silver .999 & Copper .999
pillars.body: Certified precious metals, minted in limited, numbered editions.

pillars.title: Ultra High Relief
pillars.body: High-relief minting for exceptional detail and depth.

pillars.title: Official Licenses
pillars.body: Officially licensed pieces with a nominal certificate of authenticity.

faq.a: Member card, silver .999 and copper .999 Mystery Boxes, a permanent member number, a private community, points on purchases and priority access to pre-sales.

faq.q: Does Prime assign me a member number?
faq.a: Yes. When you make the reservation ($50/€50) your member number is assigned and is permanent. It is deducted from the full payment.

faq.q: Can I upgrade to Prestige later?
faq.a: Yes. You can upgrade to a higher tier while keeping your member number.
Pieces in silver .999 and copper .999 with an element of surprise and a guaranteed minimum value.
It's an annual renewable membership; your member status and number are permanent.

prime.title: Prime Club
prime.tagline: Your gateway to the Legacy Fan universe.
prime.body: The first premium tier of the Legacy Fan ecosystem: an entry experience with real metal, a Mystery Box, a private community and preferred access to content, benefits, points and pre-sales. Accessible, collectible and aspirational.
prime.slogan: Real metal · Element of surprise · Private access
prime.renewalNote: Renewable annual membership · permanent member number
includes: Legacy Fan Club Member ID card
.999 silver Mystery Box (valued at €99 / $115)
.999 copper Mystery Box (valued at €19 / $23)
Private community channel (Telegram / Discord)
Exclusive previews of upcoming launches
Private newsletter and exclusive YouTube channel
Priority access to pre-sales
Upgrade raffles and points on purchases
Option to upgrade to a higher tier
Referral program
conditions: Renewable annual membership; member status and number are permanent.
Special discounts and promotions for active members only.
Mystery Box contents keep the element of surprise, with a guaranteed minimum.
Points, promotions and discounts apply to the premium, never to the metal spot value.
Priority over the general public; behind higher tiers in limited pre-sales.
Shipping, taxes, returns and availability subject to legal confirmation per jurisdiction.

faq.q: How is Prestige different from Prime?
faq.a: Prestige brings together the inaugural pieces, the lowest numbering and the highest member privileges of the Legacy Fan ecosystem.
Yes. Prestige members get the lowest available numbering.
A permanent discount for Prestige members, applied to the premium, never to the metal spot value.

faq.q: How do the reservation and payment work?
faq.a: The reservation amount is deducted from the final payment; the balance is paid at closing. The reservation already assigns your member number.

faq.q: What does the inaugural coin include?
faq.a: A 3 oz inaugural coin in silver .999, plus a 1 kg colorized copper .999 gift and silver .999 and copper .999 Mystery Boxes.

items.q: Does the reservation assign me a member number?
items.a: Yes. When you reserve ($50/€50) your member number is assigned immediately. The amount is deducted from the full payment.

items.q: Can I choose or change club when I pay?
items.a: Yes. The reservation is generic; you choose or confirm your club (Prime or Prestige) when completing payment.
No. Legacy Fan products are collectible items. They do not constitute a financial product or any promise of future returns.
